pre_condition: The process is invoked with command-line arguments. --phase is required and must be parseable as an integer. --layers is required and must be a string. --batch-size, --output-dir, --resume, and --dry-run are optional.
post_condition: Returns a Namespace object with attributes: phase (int) — the value of --phase parsed as an integer; layers (str) — the value of --layers; batch_size (int) — the value of --batch-size, defaulting to 2 if omitted; output_dir (str or None) — the value of --output-dir, defaulting to None if omitted; dry_run (bool) — True if --dry-run flag is present, False otherwise; resume (bool) — True if --resume flag is present, False otherwise. Each attribute reflects the corresponding command-line argument value after standard argparse parsing. If --phase or --layers is absent, argparse causes the process to exit with a non-zero exit code before parse_args returns.
